changes: Use ordinary SFT project trainer and its deterministic per-epoch shuffled sampler, instead of the diagnostic cyclic sampler.
Fresh seed8 selected-block39 initialization, not imported A or a continuation of the successful one-row diagnostic.
Use the new exact in-model bounded prefix LRU instead of an externally serialized diagnostic prefix cache.
Prepare through the normal raw-record SFT importer then require byte-identical prepared train.jsonl before training.

task_scope: Training fit across three previously selected complete historical Metal edits from one lineage; no held-out quality claim.

settings.initialization: fresh seed8 model initialization with selected block39; B exactly zero; no previous adapter loaded
settings.optimizer: MLX Adam, bias_correction=False, beta1=.9, beta2=.999, eps1e-8, fresh state

prelaunch_gates: Freeze runtime/source after tests; bind its implementation/dependency identity in the new project and run receipt. This protocol does not approve changed numerical code after preparation.

Normal --prepare-only must produce exactly three training rows and no valid/test rows; sha256(data/train.jsonl) must equal expected_prepared_sha256 and all IDs/loss_start must equal the predeclared rows.
Verify saved seed8/rank4/alpha8/layers[39]/checkpoint mode and resource settings, then run serially with no competing GPU workload.
Use ordinary model and fresh optimizer construction; do not import/rescale a favorable adapter or alter learning rate after observing intermediate results.
Enable final_fit_examples=3 only after preserve-mode and bound-receipt tests pass in the frozen runtime; no active GPU computation during source freeze.
evaluation: Evaluate all three complete training rows in fresh separate base and adapter processes under the same frozen source/mode/chunk; score original IDs/masks without truncation.
Record exact selected-row data identity, target counts204/811/1877, token-weighted mean and equal-row macro mean, every per-row paired loss, logits changes and per-token diagnostics.
Report added-code/comment/header/copied-context metrics only alongside the primary full-target metric; no favorable-category substitution.
Audit all12 real optimizer updates, actual sample cursor/order, finite parameters/moments, checksums and exact selected tensor scope; preserve failed and intermediate results.
Verify full uncached final score against any cache-assisted score. A prefix cache must not change model outputs or gradients.
If only aggregate fit improves while a row regresses, report mixed fitting rather than all-case success.

After saving step12, score all first3 immutable training rows in the existing training mode using the in-memory cache, without an optimizer call. Save per-row targets/predictions/NLL/logit hashes, exact checkpoint/source/data identities and before/after cache counters.

Fresh base and reloaded adapter evaluations each run in their own new process with prefix_cache_mib=0. Require matching target IDs/counts, per-row logit digests and token scores within the declared 1e-6 NLL tolerance. Claim real warm-cache parity only if all3 final-probe forwards registered hits and no new misses.

decision_rules.primary: Fresh final token-weighted NLL must decrease by more than1e-6 against its own zero-B baseline; every per-row and macro result is still required.
decision_rules.stronger_fit: Every row improves by more than1e-6 and aggregate/macro improve; still training fit, not independent quality.
decision_rules.failure: No resolved aggregate decrease, nonfinite state, identity mismatch or incorrect cache parity preserves failed run and blocks a successful-fit claim.
decision_rules.quality: No kernel-quality promotion from NLL. Independent generated edits must apply, build, pass correctness and beat paired timing controls on target hardware.
decision_rules.cache_verification: No mismatched output is acceptable. Absent/incomplete probe or fewer than3 measured warm hits means cache verification is incomplete, even if aggregate training fit improved. A numerical match without full warm reuse must be labeled accordingly.

amendments.reason: Explicitly verify real in-model frozen-prefix reuse against fresh uncached scores after all12 updates. No change to data, optimizer, initialization or update budget.
